title: Custom trace views in the MLflow trace explorer are in Beta
body: You can now build custom trace views in the Databricks MLflow trace explorer. Describe the layout you want in plain language, and Genie generates a reusable view that surfaces the trace fields, metrics, and feedback controls most relevant to your review workflow. See [Build a custom trace view](/aws/en/mlflow3/genai/tracing/observe-with-traces/custom-trace-view).
